title: spectrum-compare/1: the cosine of two MS2 spectra at nominal mass, `mzlab-cli spectrum compare`
description: Two spectra cut into nominal bins (`/api/spectrum` with rebin=nominal) and matched bin to bin within `params.tol` Da; the cosine is the engine's (square-root intensities, `mzlab_lib::scores::cosine_from_pairs`). Code: crates/mzlab-lib/src/speccmp.rs (the function the site .wasm, the app and the CLI call), crates/mzlab-cli/src/spectrum_compare.rs (the selection of the scans).

tol.description: Largest distance between two bin centres that still match, Da; 0 = the same bin.

ce_tol.description: Collision energies that differ by more than this, eV, give the warning warn.spectrum.ceDiffer.

default.description: The parameters that took their default (every automatic choice is logged).

matched.description: The matched ions in the order of the bins of A, with both intensities.

bin_b.description: Bin centre of B (differs from `bin` only with tol above 0).

mz_a.description: Centre of mass of the bin in A.

a.description: Counts of the bin in A.

warnings.description: Each has `key` (warn.spectrum.ceDiffer, ceMixed, ceUnknown or precursorDiffer) and the values its text names.

query.description: The `/api/spectrum` query that selected the scans.

ce.description: The collision energy, eV; null when the scans carry none or several.

ce_values.description: The distinct collision energies of the scans.

dropped_bins.description: Bins with no intensity above zero, left out.

explained.description: matched / total: the share of this spectrum the other one accounts for.
